scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic, using the exact canonical product law, geometric local CLT, tail bounds, LLN and Riemann sums. Exhaustive finite-state and numerical checks support, not certify, the infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 0<q<1, specified near-critical or supercritical occupancy and two weak-asymmetry scalings only; static canonical laws, not dynamical relaxation. Historical priority remains uncertain for the complete 2016 thesis text.
title: Two scaling windows for competing slow-site condensates in a zero-range ring
